reply.rationale: Most symbols are best treated as opaque lexemes: shared letters, digits, or candidate prefixes do not reliably yield compositional paradigms. Two small construction families are defensible. First, t6 / cool6 / cool2 support a shared PROC_WITH_SCOPE + SCOPE template: the root slot contrasts in the same 6-frame (t vs cool), and the scope slot contrasts in the same cool-frame (2 vs 6), with predictable meanings. Second, wsAll / bellCtrAll support PROC_DISTRIBUTED + DISTRIBUTION: ws and bellCtr contrast in the same All-frame, and All contributes a stable 'each/all faces' distribution. All other items lack sufficient same-frame substitution with stable compositional contributions, so they remain lexical.
